title: Certified artifacts for R_cyc(K4, P6^alt) = 16
description: Independent encoders, a combined DIMACS instance, an ASCII DRAT certificate, checker output, and a short manuscript establishing the exact cyclic Ramsey number R_cyc(K4, P6^alt) = 16. The certificate proves that every valid 15-vertex blue graph is three disjoint K5 components. The project used GPT-5.6-SOL and Qwen3.8max as disclosed in the manuscript.
